charges.conditional_model: per fold/group/role/expert/state: three counts, fourth derived from latent-state total
charges.latent_model: per fold/group/role: one count, second derived
charges.marginal_model: per fold/expert/role: three counts, fourth derived
charges.scale_bytes: identical MDL cancellation; included exactly in private capacity and both read ledgers

controls.execution_order: unreachable until favorable source threshold and at least one strict capacity/read endpoint survive
controls.family: independent per-expert/per-role bijective affine coordinate permutations

cross_fit.model_selection: partition, initializer, probabilities, and assignments fitted without held-out fold

decision.favorable_gate: (marginal held-out data bits - private conditional held-out data bits)/UpDown weights; all common costs free
decision.promotion: fully charged source gain minus max(0, maximum matched-control charged gain) >= exact threshold, positive strict read endpoint, finite codec still required

grouping.family: one flat equal-size partition per fold; no hierarchy
grouping.partition_search: deterministic greedy equal partition from training-only pairwise four-symbol mutual information

latent.semantics: arbitrary per-coordinate binary state within frozen finite hard-EM search; not tied to modal symbols

physical.strict_gate: for every routed expert, both page-amortized physical and nonpadding decodable amplification are strictly below 2
physical.warning: capacity/read projection only; no finite entropy coder or payload runner exists

universality: uses only legal SwiGLU expert geometry, role, public coordinates, quantized labels, and transmitted fields; no provenance, model identity, reference checkpoint, or external expert
